response.reasoning: Brief specifies a G+5 apartment tower with explicit mention of "habitable terrace" use via roof access requirement. Tower towers in v1 Slice 2B.3 support mumty (stair-access enclosure on roof) for terrace access. No compound wall, entry gate, car porch, or servant quarter is applicable to a tower unit. Stilt parking is already in the template; lift and fire stair are core structural elements, not extensions.
